items.label: Delton Technology IR activity record: 2026-08 (10-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Management (IR record): PCIe 6.0 product prices are expected to rise

set.signal: Management (IR record): PCIe 6.0 product prices are expected to rise versus the previous generation with higher layer counts and material grades; some platforms have started small-batch shipments and other platforms are expected to ship in Q1 or Q2 2027, depending on chip mass-production timing. The Thailand base currently makes mainly general-purpose compute boards because the local supply chain is thin and many materials come from mainland China; more AI orders will follow as its capability and local supply improve. Equipment added to the existing Thailand phase 1 plant is being installed and commissioned, with production starting progressively in Q4 2026 and new capacity in 2027.

items.reason: Skill section 2: use of proceeds is a financing term; 'with H-share proceeds' is removed. The Thailand equipment build-out (the operating programme) and its timing stay unchanged.
items.evidence: Answer 8 (translated): using H-share proceeds, the company is adding equipment to the existing Thailand phase 1 plant, now in installation and commissioning, expected to start production progressively in Q4 2026 and bring new capacity in 2027.
